name: Okavango Delta
tagline: Africa's Eden — An Inland Delta Teeming With Life
intro: The Okavango Delta is one of Africa's great wonders — a vast inland delta where the Okavango River fans out across the Kalahari desert, creating a lush mosaic of channels, lagoons, and islands that support extraordinary biodiversity. There are no fences here; wildlife roams freely across pristine wilderness.

signatureExperiences.title: Mokoro Excursions
signatureExperiences.description: Glide silently through reed-lined channels in a traditional dugout canoe, poled by expert local guides who have navigated these waters since childhood.

signatureExperiences.title: Walking Safaris
signatureExperiences.description: Experience Africa at ground level with armed professional guides, tracking wildlife through island interiors and learning to read the landscape.

signatureExperiences.title: Elephant Encounters
signatureExperiences.description: The Okavango supports one of Africa's largest elephant populations. Watch herds swimming across channels and feeding in the papyrus.

signatureExperiences.title: Night Game Drives
signatureExperiences.description: After dark, the delta reveals a different cast of characters — civets, genets, aardvarks, and lions on the prowl.

wildlifeHighlights.notes: Botswana hosts the world's largest elephant population. Delta elephants are expert swimmers.
One of Africa's rarest predators; the Okavango is one of their last strongholds.
This semi-aquatic antelope is found almost exclusively in swamp habitats and is a delta speciality.

lodging.name: andBeyond Xaranna
lodging.description: An intimate 9-suite camp in a private concession on Chief's Island, offering outstanding wildlife viewing year-round.

lodging.name: Mombo Camp
lodging.description: Long regarded as one of Africa's finest camps, situated on the wildlife-rich tip of Chief's Island in the UNESCO World Heritage site.

bestTimeToVisit: May–October (dry season) for best wildlife concentration and water levels for mokoro
